senses.sense_definition: Any of various flowering plants of the family Gentianaceae, typically found in temperate and alpine regions and noted for their vivid blue or violet flowers.

examples.text: While hiking through the high alpine meadows, we spotted a rare blue <w>gentian</w> growing among the rocks.
The bright color of her eyes matched the vibrant petals of a wild <w>gentian</w>.

senses.sense_definition: The dried roots and rhizome of certain species of gentian, used medicinally as a bitter tonic or flavoring agent.

examples.text: The herbalist prepared an extract of <w>gentian</w> to help stimulate the patient's poor appetite.
Traditional aromatic bitters often include dried <w>gentian</w> to provide a deep, bitter taste.
